# BubbleRAN Persistent-Interference Anomaly Dataset

**Aliases:** anomaly-detection-persistent-interference

A controlled 5G-lab KPI dataset for anomaly detection, with approximately two hours of one-second RAN observations and a binary persistent-interference anomaly label.
